description: The eager-parameter counterfactual: a generator's parameter list runs at the call however lazy its body is, so `async function*` can sync-throw and is exempt from the carve-out — while the same default on a plain `async` function becomes a rejection carried by the function's own color.

diagnostics.message: Call to `lazyBodyEagerParameters` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `lazyBodyEagerParameters` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.

Awaiting `plainAsync()` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the call that produced it has a body that was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try { await … } catch`, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
